report: TASK-184 测试套件仍写生产主网库（确定缺陷 · 开放）
authority: statement level probe plus an external read-only PRAGMA data_version sampler; the collector itself only ever opens the live store with mode=ro and PRAGMA query_only=ON; no broadcast

fullRun20261123.kind: offline analysis of the captured probe artifacts of a full suite run
fullRun20261123.reproductionVerified: the preserved artifacts reproduce 185 commits, data_version 2 -> 187, 1632 connections and 362 DML statements with the same per table distribution

silentControl.purpose: the same sampler records zero commits while pytest is idle, so the commits observed inside a run window are attributable to the run itself and not to a background writer

rootCauses.why: core.local_kv resolves its default path to the main chain store, so the production read paths under bot/page_state write the control panel page state into the live database
rootCauses.writes: control panel page state (parameters collection) and the flash loan pool discovery snapshot

rootCauses.why: the liquidation discovery window writes the schema_migrations record of the main chain store; this is a different key from the one TASK-183 closed

rootCauses.statement: INSERT INTO cow_execution_reviews / DELETE FROM cow_execution_attempts
rootCauses.why: the arbitrage daemon writes its attempt log into the main chain store; core/db/builders.py imports delete_rows by name, which bypasses the conftest guard that watches function names instead of connections

consequences: The main store byte comparison cannot be used as evidence while a test run is in flight (the 65th round caveat stands).
The existing assumption that the test suite does not write to the production store is refuted.
The live store accumulates test residue: control panel page state rows and cow_execution_* business rows.
The writes reach the live operation gates, not only cosmetic state: a test run resets the pause guards to their defaults.

operationalImpact.method: read-only count of the rows whose updated_at / created_at fall on the day of the test run

kvEntriesParameters.valuesWritten: the defaults: paused=false, order_submission_enabled=true, consecutive_failure_count=0, pause_reason=null
kvEntriesParameters.reading: a test run therefore resets the live submission gate and the live liquidation gate to their default state; had the live system been paused by a real failure streak, the test run would have cleared that pause
kvEntriesParameters.currentState: unpaused, which is also the default; no manual restore was needed

cowExecutionReviews.reading: the tests remove most of their own rows with their own DELETE; one row per run survives in a live business table

operationalImpact.note: these counts are measured, not estimated; the numbers above come from the same read-only session that produced the residue

remainingWork: Move the guard from watching function names to watching connections: force mode=ro on every live chain store connection so a write fails inside SQLite instead of being noticed afterwards.
Make the default path of core.local_kv and bot/page_state injectable so a test never resolves to the main chain store.
Add a guard that asserts PRAGMA data_version of the main store does not change across a full pytest run.
notClaimed: This report does not claim that the record layer is already fed: TASK-165 (the Rust production publish path) is still open.
